description:
As a Software Engineer at the Professional Technical 4 level, you will serve as a senior data engineer designing and building enterprise data solutions that support reporting, analytics, automation, and data-driven decision making across the laboratory.
  
 This role combines hands-on engineering with data architecture and technical leadership. You will work with stakeholders, analysts, architects, and engineers to translate complex business needs into scalable data solutions. You will help shape the architecture and strategy of our enterprise data platform, modernize our data engineering capabilities, and explore opportunities to incorporate AI into how we develop, manage, and use enterprise data.
  
 Responsibilities
 Design and build scalable data pipelines, integrations, data models, and enterprise data solutions. 
 Help architect and evolve enterprise data warehouse, analytics, and cloud data platforms. 
 Work directly with stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into effective data solutions. 
 Develop data models that support reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and other enterprise data needs. 
 Explore and apply AI-assisted approaches to data engineering, including opportunities to improve data modeling, transformation, quality, development, and automation. 
 Apply software engineering best practices including testing, source control, code review, and CI/CD. 
 Improve data quality, governance, reliability, performance, and maintainability. 
 Help define technical standards, architecture, and the long-term direction of the enterprise data platform. 
 Provide technical project leadership to other engineers. 
 Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for modernization and innovation.
 
 This is a fully remote position.

 Competencies
 Analytic Ability: Uses data, judgment, and critical thinking to solve complex problems.
 Systems Thinking: Understands how data, applications, and business processes interact across an enterprise environment.
 Decision Making: Evaluates technical options, tradeoffs, risks, and long-term maintainability.
 Learning Agility: Quickly learns new technologies and adapts to changing requirements.
 Ownership: Independently takes responsibility for complex problems and solutions.
 Collaboration: Communicates effectively across technical and business teams and helps others develop their skills.
 
 
 Position Requirements 
  
 Required Skills and Qualifications
 PA4: Minimum of a Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of related experience, or a minimum of a Master's degree and 4+ years, or equivalent.
 US citizenship: To perform the essential functions of this position successful applicants must provide proof of U.S. citizenship, which is required to comply with federal regulations and contract
 Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies, including Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, or Databricks.
 Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and enterprise data warehouse environments.
 Experience with Power BI, semantic models, or other business intelligence platforms.
 Experience with Informatica or similar ETL/ELT platforms.
 Familiarity with Microsoft Purview or other data governance and cataloging tools.
 Experience with APIs, cloud or hybrid data architectures, and enterprise application integration.
 Experience contributing to data architecture, analytics strategy, or technology roadmaps.
 Experience applying AI or AI-assisted development tools to data engineering, analytics, software development, or related workflows.
 Ability to model Argonne's core values of impact, safety, respect, integrity and teamwork.
 
 
 Job Family 
Professional Technical (PT) 
 
 Job Profile 
Applications Development 4 
 
 Worker Type 
Regular 
 
 Time Type 
Full time 
 
 
The expected hiring range for this position is $106,455.00 - $166,069.80. 
 
 Please note that the pay range information is a general guideline only. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, business considerations, internal equity, and external market pay for comparable jobs. Additionally, comprehensive benefits are part of the total rewards package. 
 
 Click here to view Argonne employee benefits!
 
 
 As an equal employment opportunity employer, and in accordance with our core values of impact, safety, respect, integrity and teamwork, Argonne National Laboratory is committed to a safe and welcoming workplace that fosters collaborative scientific discovery and innovation. Argonne encourages everyone to apply for employment. Argonne is committed to nondiscrimination and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law. 
 
 
 Argonne employees, and certain guest researchers and contractors, are subject to particular restrictions related to participation in Foreign Government Sponsored or Affiliated Activities, as defined and detailed in United States Department of Energy Order 486.1A. You will be asked to disclose any such participation in the application phase for review by Argonne's Legal Department.   
 
 All Argonne offers of employment are contingent upon a background check that includes an assessment of criminal conviction history conducted on an individualized and case-by-case basis.  Please be advised that Argonne positions require upon hire (or may require in the future) for the individual be to obtain a government access authorization that involves additional background check requirements.  Failure to obtain or maintain such government access authorization could result in the withdrawal of a job offer or future termination of employment.
